name: Use one-hot encoding for low-cardinality categorical features

conditions.description: No categorical column is high cardinality.

reason_template: Categorical columns are present and low-cardinality encoding is suitable for transparent preprocessing.
advantages: Works well for small categorical domains
limitations: Can expand feature space if there are many categories

name: Warn about high-cardinality categorical features

conditions.description: At least one categorical feature has many distinct values.

recommendation: Consider a careful encoding strategy for high-cardinality columns.
reason_template: High-cardinality categorical features may make one-hot encoding less efficient, so a cautious encoding strategy is recommended.
limitations: Does not prescribe an advanced encoding algorithm yet
notes: Keep the first implementation simple and transparent.
